about.ctaLine: Ready to automate your next system?
about.descriptionHtml:
COO and co-founder of DevRolin. I architect agentic AI systems, automate complex workflows, and build premium digital products for clients across the US, UK, UAE, and beyond.

Everything I ship is custom-built no templates, no drag-and-drop shortcuts. I work at the intersection of AI, automation, and premium web development. If something doesn't exist yet, I build it.

My focus is on agentic systems that operate autonomously, handling complex tasks without human intervention. From legal intake AI to multilingual voice platforms, I build software that scales.

DevRolin serves global clients with a remote-first team of engineers and designers.

partnersText.eyebrow: Trusted To Build What Businesses Depend On
partnersText.subheading: I help businesses turn disconnected tools, manual processes, and ambitious AI ideas into systems that actually work together.
partnersText.description1: From the first workflow to the final deployment, I focus on what matters: less manual work, stronger operations, and systems built to scale with the business.
partnersText.description2: From CRM automation and AI agents to custom APIs and SaaS platforms, every build starts with one question:
partnersText.finalQuestion: What does this need to solve for the business?

workText.heading: Built to solve real business problems.
workText.subheading: AI automation, CRM systems, AI agents and SaaS products built around one thing: Making the business work better.

work.title: CV LABZ
work.desc: From raw information to an ATS-ready CV in minutes. Built an AI-powered SaaS platform that transforms user data into structured, professional resumes automatically.

work.title: THE DIGITAL COUNSEL
work.desc: Follow-up that happens even when your team is busy. Built a 14-day automated SMS and email system that keeps client communication moving without relying on manual follow-ups.

work.title: CHERRETT CHIROPRACTIC
work.desc: Turning an inactive patient database back into appointments. Built an AI-powered reactivation system that starts conversations, handles responses and moves qualified patients toward booking.

work.title: PREPARE2SWIM
work.desc: Automation built to support a 1M+ audience. Fixed critical email-deliverability issues and automated the ManyChat → Kit lead journey for a high-volume digital business.

work.title: PIXELLIFT
work.desc: From low-quality images to usable product assets automatically. Built an AI SaaS workflow that enhances product images without repetitive manual editing.

work.title: LOOMO
work.desc: One platform connecting customers, drivers and payments. Built a multi-sided ride-booking system covering customer journeys, driver operations, payments and live tracking.
